mcqs.question: What is the main purpose of system analysis?
options: To study system requirements and improve solutions
To design only the user interface
mcqs.correct_answer: To study system requirements and improve solutions

mcqs.question: What is a requirement in system analysis?
options: A documented need the system must satisfy
mcqs.correct_answer: A documented need the system must satisfy

mcqs.question: What is the difference between functional and non-functional requirements?
options: Functional requirements define what the system does, non-functional define quality attributes
Functional requirements are optional, non-functional are mandatory
Functional requirements are for UI only
mcqs.correct_answer: Functional requirements define what the system does, non-functional define quality attributes

mcqs.question: What is feasibility analysis used for?
options: To check whether a proposed system is practical and viable
mcqs.correct_answer: To check whether a proposed system is practical and viable

mcqs.question: Which of the following is a common type of feasibility study?
mcqs.correct_answer: Technical feasibility

mcqs.question: What is technical feasibility concerned with?
options: Whether the solution can be built with available technology and skills
mcqs.correct_answer: Whether the solution can be built with available technology and skills

mcqs.question: What is economic feasibility concerned with?
mcqs.correct_answer: Cost-benefit evaluation of the system

mcqs.question: What is operational feasibility concerned with?
options: Whether the organization can adopt and use the system effectively
mcqs.correct_answer: Whether the organization can adopt and use the system effectively

mcqs.question: What is requirement elicitation?
mcqs.correct_answer: Collecting requirements from stakeholders

mcqs.question: Which technique is commonly used to gather requirements?
mcqs.correct_answer: Stakeholder interviews

mcqs.question: What is a stakeholder in system analysis?
options: Anyone affected by or interested in the system
Only the end customer who pays
mcqs.correct_answer: Anyone affected by or interested in the system

mcqs.question: What is a use case?
options: A description of how a user interacts with the system to achieve a goal
mcqs.correct_answer: A description of how a user interacts with the system to achieve a goal

mcqs.question: Why are use case diagrams useful?
options: They help visualize actors and system interactions
They are used only for database indexing
They are only for UI colors
mcqs.correct_answer: They help visualize actors and system interactions

mcqs.question: What is process modeling in system analysis?
options: Representing how information and tasks flow through a system
mcqs.correct_answer: Representing how information and tasks flow through a system

mcqs.question: What is a data flow diagram mainly used for?
options: Showing movement of data between processes, stores, and entities
mcqs.correct_answer: Showing movement of data between processes, stores, and entities

mcqs.question: What is gap analysis?
options: Comparing current state and desired state
mcqs.correct_answer: Comparing current state and desired state

mcqs.question: What is system scope?
options: The defined boundaries of what the system will and will not cover
The zoom level of a diagram
mcqs.correct_answer: The defined boundaries of what the system will and will not cover

mcqs.question: Why is requirement prioritization important?
options: It helps focus on the most valuable or critical needs first
It removes the need for stakeholders
mcqs.correct_answer: It helps focus on the most valuable or critical needs first

mcqs.question: What is a constraint in system analysis?
options: A limitation the solution must work within
mcqs.correct_answer: A limitation the solution must work within

mcqs.question: What is the role of documentation in system analysis?
options: To clearly communicate requirements, assumptions, and decisions
mcqs.correct_answer: To clearly communicate requirements, assumptions, and decisions

scenario_mcqs.question: A company wants to replace a manual attendance process with software. What should be done first?
A proposed solution is powerful but too expensive for the organization. Which analysis identifies this issue?
Users keep requesting features outside the original project boundaries. What needs to be clarified?
A team needs to understand how invoice data moves from customer input to approval and storage. What model is most helpful?
Management wants to know whether staff can realistically adopt a new enterprise system. What should be evaluated?
A project has too many requested features and limited time. What should the analyst do?
A team wants to compare the current paper-based workflow with the target digital workflow. What technique is best?
An analyst needs to understand how a cashier and inventory manager interact with a retail system. What artifact is most useful?
A solution idea depends on a technology the current team does not know how to maintain. Which issue is this?
Different departments describe the same requirement in conflicting ways. What should the analyst do next?
options: Clarify and validate requirements with stakeholders
scenario_mcqs.correct_answer: Clarify and validate requirements with stakeholders
